summary: Performance bug-fix verification + regressions. Fresh-session Ascent intro plays and hero reveals crisply (~57.6 fps over 5s, only 3 long-frames >50ms). Programmatic full-page scroll through hero → JaipurRising → Credibility → Nine Philosophies produced ~48.6 fps with 11 long-frames across 3.7s of continuous scrolling (no stalls, no frozen segments) — the filter-free radial-gradient glow blobs (3 present, will-change-transform) are visibly rendered behind the headline and drift over time. Footer bottom line reads exactly '© 2026 PLATINUM GROUP' (no JAIPUR / RERA); all 6 footer links (HOME/GREENS/GREENS OPULENCE/ENQUIRE/PRIVACY/TERMS) present and navigable. Mobile (390x844) data-testid='mobile-cta-visit' has href='/enquire' and click lands on plain /enquire URL. Zero console errors on /, /opulence, /greens, /enquire.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx glow implementation is now GPU-friendly: uses only transform (x/y) animations with will-change-transform and no filter/blur — good fix. 3 radial-gradient blobs are cheap to composite.

Hero.jsx background scale+y useTransform still causes layout re-paints on the black background layer during scroll; if further perf tuning is needed, consider setting willChange: 'transform' on that motion.div too (minor).
Consider prefers-reduced-motion guard for the infinite drifting blobs and hero parallax (a11y polish, not a blocker).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf sampling used requestAnimationFrame counting to measure fps and long-frames (>50ms) during intro and during programmatic scroll. Results are well within 'smooth' thresholds. To reproduce fresh intro: navigate then sessionStorage.clear() and reload; to skip, set sessionStorage 'pg-ascent'='1'. Footer/mobile CTA data-testids: site-footer, mobile-cta-visit.
